In such a ball screw mechanism, for example, a rotary drive source such as a motor or the like is connected with respect to the screw shaft, and by rotation of the screw shaft, the rotational motion of the screw is converted through the balls into linear motion of the nut member, whereby the nut member is displaced linearly along the axis of the screw shaft.

With the aforementioned ball screw mechanism, it is necessary for balls to be circulated between the nut member and the screw shaft accompanying displacement of the nut member in the axial direction. Owing thereto, for example, as in the ball screw mechanism disclosed in Japanese Laid-Open Patent Publication No. 2005-048845, end members are provided respectively on both ends of the nut member having circulation passages therein, and a return passage is disposed along the axial direction of the nut member interconnecting the end members.
